body.title: Use bounded views in execution and mandatory coverage assessment
body.summary: Convert code/design assessment adapters, selected-code extraction, prompt assembly and test-coverage readers to bounded task/file windows under current private generation borrows.
acceptanceChecks: Complete submitted review scope and mandatory test-coverage assessment remain identical for task/whole-story routes; no module omitted because of size. Test execution remains optional, scope and coverage do not.

Final prompt assembly, serialization and provider transport copies are included in memory reservations/high-water instrumentation; do not hide whole-task/whole-packet hydration behind a lazy accessor.

Borrow/release/cancel rules hold through provider/native consumption; no source/provider use from unqualified or revoked descriptors. Keep existing model capability and CLI provider path; design prompts use current paths, not copied artifacts.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Bounded execution and mandatory coverage traversal for code/design task/story routes: no skipped modules, prompt/provider transport copies charged, borrow invalidation/cancellation and no premature provider dispatch.
